name: Tobiichi Origami
source:
Tobiichi Origami is a student of Raizen High School. She is known for having the highest grades in school, including P.E. She is also a member of AST (Anti-Spirit Team) as one of the most skilled members.

Origami has a great hatred towards Spirits. This is because five years ago when the first great spacequake happened, [spoiler]her parents died in a fire caused by an unknown Spirit. She joined the AST for a chance for revenge.[/spoiler]

Origami is in love with Shidou, so much so that she frequently stalks him. [spoiler]Origami originally met Shidou five years ago when the first great spacequake happened. However, Shidou does not remember this.[/spoiler]
